description: List the notices the Panda team sent to the account (tips, alerts, news) — the ones shown in the dashboard notice card and Notifications panel. Only the account owner and admins have notices: any other user gets an empty list (not an error). Status: 'sent' = unread, 'read' = dismissed, 'completed' = the user already acted on it (clicked its button). Returns up to 100 [{id, notice_type, title, text, primary_button, secondary_button, status, created_at, read_at, completed_at}].

status.description: Filter by status ('sent' = unread). Omit for all.

name: panda_list_notices
title: List Notices
